name: Sangay National Park
description: Sangay National Park stretches across the Ecuadorian Andes, climbing from steamy rainforest at about 900 metres to glaciers above 5,000 metres. Two active volcanoes, Sangay and Tungurahua, smoulder above cloud forest, grassy páramo and hundreds of lakes. Its remote slopes shelter mountain tapirs and Andean condors, making it one of Ecuador's wildest landscapes.
